capability.summary: Text model for software engineering and analysis.
capability.problem_space: Text model for software engineering and analysis. Applicable tasks include code generation, debugging, multi-step analysis, tool-assisted problem solving. Accepts text input and produces text output. External tools are required to execute programs, browse sources, or modify files; generated instructions alone do not perform those actions.
